newsitem.title: UK: BOE gives UK money market 321 mln stg further help.
newsitem.headline: BOE gives UK money market 321 mln stg further help.

text.p: The Bank of England said it provided the UK money market with a further 321 million stg of assistance at established interest rates.
The Bank said it alloted 165 million stg outright in bills maturing on or before May 1 and 156 million stg in repos to April 29 and May 1.
It has provided total liquidity of 1.006 billion stg to the market so far on Wednesday after forecasting a money market shortage of 1.25 billion stg.
The Bank said no use had been made of the discount house late repo facility by 1350 GMT.
